body:
Friends can now hop into a map together at any time and keep riding, with no lobby wait.

**Joining and staying in**
- **Host Game → Select Track → Ride** starts riding right away.
- Invite links join the live room at any time, and the new rider appears beside someone already there.
- If everyone has left and the room has ended, the same link opens it again on its track.
- Any rider who drops or reloads gets the same slot (and color) back within 30 s.
- If the host leaves, the next rider takes over and everyone keeps riding.

**In-ride**
- **Pause → Change ATV and Rider** swaps your ride in place, at your current spot.
- The host's **Pause → Select Track** moves everyone to the new course.

**Smoothness and contacts**
- Remote riders use an adaptive jitter buffer, follow curved jump arcs, and ease out of corrections instead of snapping.
- Nearby riders are drawn closer to their current position, so collisions line up with what you see.
- Someone joining no longer resets everyone else's remote motion.
- Rider contacts are yawed boxes with spin from off-center hits and a bounce when landing on someone. The original wreck classifier still decides who gets thrown.
- The Arlington train runs on the relay clock, so it never freezes when the host pauses or leaves.

**Menus and protocol**
- Menu labels use the executable's own strings: Host Game, Join Game, Change ATV and Rider, Leave Game, Copy invite link.
- Overhead markers show only the rider's name.
- The rider name is remembered.
- Protocol is now v4; tabs opened before this release must reload.

**Host verification** (local Rust relay, actual WASM, original content, one Mac):
- `make check` passes.
- `tools/test_multiplayer_dropin.mjs` passes:
  - the invite guest met the host 10.3 ft apart;
  - remote motion replicated;
  - the ATV change was seen by the host;
  - the host changed track from env01 to env02 for both riders;
  - a reload reclaimed slot 1;
  - the room handed off when the host left;
  - a 390 px late joiner rode in;

- `tools/test_multiplayer_features.mjs` passes:

body:
### What does this PR do?

The `nixos wiki` engine uses the generic `mediawiki` engine with
`search_type: text` (`srwhat=text`). On wiki.nixos.org this backend returns
related pages but not the article itself: searching `!nixw Wayland` never
shows the main *Wayland* article.

Probed against the live MediaWiki API:

- `srwhat=text` → `Viber`, `HMCL/zh`, `HMCL/en`, `HMCL`, `Wallpapers for Wayland`
- `srwhat=title` → `Wayland`, `Wallpapers for Wayland`

so this switches the engine to `search_type: title`, the same value the
`free software directory` engine already uses.

### How to test this PR locally?

- Live API probe above (no repo test infra covers engine configs).
- `settings.yml` remains valid YAML; engine `search_type` values are
  constrained to `nearmatch`/`text`/`title` by `mediawiki.py`.

author: symow07
body:
The owner, 2026-10-15 (the isolation sweep, item 4): "Per-workspace numbering, no shared counter, no YW."

## Before
`generate_order_reference()` (the baseline schema) wrote `'YW-' || YYYY-MM || '-' || nextval('order_seq')`. One counter served the whole installation, and the old system's letters went on every workspace's orders. Each workspace's numbers had gaps, and a number told a buyer roughly how many orders every workspace together had made.

## Now (0162)
- Each workspace counts its own orders, per year in its own time zone: **2026-0001, 2026-0002 … 2027-0001** (`src/db/orderNumbers.ts`).
- The count is one row per workspace and year (`order_numbers`, row security), raised in the order's own transaction. An order that rolls back takes its number with it, so there's no gap. Two orders at once in one workspace wait for each other on that row.
- References are unique **per workspace** (`orders_business_reference` replaces the global `orders_order_reference_key`), so two workspaces each have a 2026-0001.
- The old function and sequence stay in the database, but the app role can no longer use them (`revoke execute`/`usage`). The `YW-${Date.now()}` fallback is gone.
- `order_numbers` joins the erasure contract as `unrelated`. Without that, every customer erasure would refuse (D19).
- A reference already issued is never rewritten. Production had **0 orders** (read-only, 2026-10-15), and nothing in the code parses the old shape: the advisor looks an order up by reference under row security, so per-workspace references are what it already expected.

## Tests
- New: `tests/integration/order-numbers.test.ts`.
  - Each workspace starts at 0001, and the same reference can exist in two workspaces.
  - A rollback leaves no gap.
  - Two orders at once get 0004 and 0005.
  - New Year's Eve 20:00 UTC is already next year in Shanghai.
  - Row security: one workspace can't see or raise another's count.
  - The app role gets "permission denied" on the old function.
  - The reference is unique within a workspace.
- New: `tests/parity/order-numbers.test.ts`.
  - Covers the shape, the year by zone, and the migration.
  - No `YW-` is left in `src/`, `tools/` or `prompts/`.
- Changed by design: the fakes (`tests/pipeline/fakes.ts`, `src/trust/harness.ts`) and three display fixtures (`calendar`, `g18-currency`, `proforma-link` parity) now use the new shape.
- Negative control: with the old counter call put back, 6 of the 9 new tests fail.

## Verification
- `npm run check`: 8301 passed.
- `npm run trust`: 44 passed.
- `npm run build`: ok.
- Integration: 1575 of 1575 ran, none skipped. The first run found one registry to fill (Practice's copy list: `order_numbers` is skipped, since a copy numbers its own orders). It was fixed in the second commit and re-run.
- `pre-pilot --scripted`: 12/12 before (main 438d9561) and 12/12 after. Scenario 10's answer now names `2026-0001 · being prepared`.

author: dastaanenajdik
body:
## What this does

Brings **everything** from [`omavcher/YouTube-Clone`](https://github.com/omavcher/YouTube-Clone) into this repo — its routes, layout logic and feature inventory — then rebuilds it as a full glassmorphism design system with a lot of extra functionality on top.

### Source clone → where it lives now

| `omavcher/YouTube-Clone` | This PR |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` — hamburger + sidebar cards, category chip row ending in a forward arrow, 4-up cards with duration badge / channel logo / verified tick / `views · age`, Shorts shelf with “Show more ⌄” | `/` — `Sidebar`, `CategoryRail`, `VideoCard`, `ShortsShelf` (Show more/less + dismiss), welcome hero, continue-watching + personalized shelves, trending rail |
| `shorts.html` — full-height vertical rows, `@username` + Subscribe, like/dislike/comment/share counts, `.up-down-btn` | `/shorts` — real embedded player per clip, tap-to-pause, glass action rail with working likes/comments, up-next list, step counter, prev/next |
| `history.html` — “Today” grouping, per-card `X` remove, `fa-trash` / `fa-pause` | `/history` — Today/Yesterday/dated grouping, per-day + per-item remove, search filter, resume-from-position card, history pause, clear-all |
| `your_channel.html` — banner + avatar + `@handle · subscribers · videos`, link row, tab chips, running preview with range progress + pause/volume/captions/gear/expand, “For You” row, 6 Shorts | `/channel` — gradient banner, identity row, tab rail + channel search, featured-upload preview wired to the shared player state, Videos / Shorts / Playlists / Community (working polls) / Membership / Manage-videos (visibility persisted) |

### Stack decision (important)

The upstream “technology” is static HTML + Bootstrap 5.3.3 + Font Awesome 6.5.1 + Open Sans with **zero** application JS. Its layout intent is ported, but the Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + `lucide-react` stack is kept: dropping in Bootstrap/Font Awesome would delete the working player, API routes, rooms and persistence. No markup, images, GIFs or icon fonts were copied (the upstream `assets/` folder is third-party trademarked media); avatars are CSS initials, thumbnails come from `i.ytimg.com`. Upstream MIT license is reproduced in `NOTICE.md`.

## Glassmorphism everywhere

One recipe in `src/app/globals.css` drives **every** interactive surface: translucent fill, `linear-gradient` shine, 1px hairline border, `backdrop-filter: blur() saturate()`, inner top highlight, deep outer shadow, sweeping `::after` sheen on buttons — over a fixed blurred aurora backdrop (that’s what the frosting actually blurs).

`html[data-theme]` + `--accent*` custom properties re-tint the entire shell (dark/light, 4 accents) without a single component changing. Legacy class names (`.button-primary`, `.icon-button`, `.category-chip`, …) are aliased onto the glass primitives so no page can escape the system.

## Extras beyond the source repo

- **Custom glass player controls**: scrub bar with chapter ticks, ±10s, volume, playback rate 0.5×–2×, captions, fullscreen, theater mode, current-chip, autoplay-next into the queue
- **⌘K / `/` command palette** (pages, actions, any cached video) + keyboard shortcuts (`k` global play/pause, `↑↓`/`j k`, `m`, `l`)
- **Queue** (watch sidebar + Library tab), **local comments** on watch + Shorts (Top/Newest, like, delete), **watch notes**, reactions, **notifications** popover with unread badge
- **Live mini-player** that survives navigation, mobile glass tab bar, collapsible icon-only sidebar rail
- **Explore**, **Subscriptions**, **Settings** (theme/accent/motion/playback/privacy/data wipe), search sorting + category chips with a real-YouTube fallback
- Community **polls**, channel **membership tiers** (demo), **manage-videos visibility**, history **pause + resume**
- Web Speech **voice search** (`en-IN`) with a graceful fallback notice
- Everything persists device-local under `ytglass.*.v1`

## Verification

```
npm run typecheck   ✅ no errors
npm run lint        ✅ 0 errors / 0 warnings
npm test            ✅ 10/10 (new feed.ts coverage: categories, affinity ranking,
                       sorting, freshness, day grouping, dedupe/takeEvery, ids, notifications)
npm run build       ✅ 21 routes
```

All 12 pages were smoke-tested through the dev server (`200`, no hydration or CSS errors).

> Note: this app never removes or bypasses YouTube ads — playback stays inside YouTube’s official embed.

author: realxhabib
body:
A match room now holds the match's shared state (Frontline's kill list, clock and end): seated players write it to the room, which orders the writes (compare-and-set on its version) and sends every new copy to everyone. Nothing is written to XApps during the match. Each player's page offers its latest copy when it signs in: an empty room (new, or after a restart) takes the first offer, and a newer one until someone writes. The copy is dropped when the room empties.

Seats come from get_match, read as the joining player alongside is_room_member, so the server still needs no Supabase secret.

body:
## What

The Products roadmap now has three milestones, one per product: Parent Hub, Staff Hub, AI Tutor. Click a milestone and a 3D device opens behind the details: a phone for Parent Hub, a laptop for Staff Hub, a desktop monitor for AI Tutor. The camera pulls back so the whole device, its depth and part of the road show.

- Roadmap design and layout are kept (winding road, numbered pins, cards, pinned scroll tour on desktop, scroll reveal on phone and tablet). The road is re-spaced for three stops.
- Each card shows the product name, its tagline and audience tag (existing translated content). The section heading is Home's "One connected school" (no new copy).
- The scene is CSS 3D only (no dependency). Its code and CSS load on the first click. Motion is `transform` and `opacity` only. Reduced motion and a saved Pause leave it still. The device screens are wireframes with the real feature names and a `[Placeholder] screen` tag. `scene/screenshots.ts` takes an image path per product, so real screenshots drop in without other changes (due 2026-10-15).
- The stop dialog is a full-window stage (card at the left, or a bottom sheet on a phone). Three bugs fixed: it sat in the top-left corner (Tailwind's reset removes the browser's auto margin), the Next title ran out of its button, and the page scrolled behind it.
- Removed from this roadmap: the six school-day stops, their times, the IoT stop and the "Day stays connected" finale. IoT stays on the rest of the site; the old link `#iot` lands at the start of the roadmap. The 3D lettering idea was built first and dropped for devices.

## Why

No story. The lead asked for a cinematic product scene on Products, then cut the roadmap to three products and replaced the 3D text with device screens (2026-10-14).

Measured, local production build, Lighthouse mobile, 3 runs each: Products branch 73-78, develop 69-74 on the same machine (nothing 3D loads before the click). These are lower than the 84-85 of this morning because develop moved (#116).

## AC covered

n/a (enhancement, no story).

## Tests added

- New and rewritten unit tests for the scene, the device screens, the dialog, the roadmap geometry and the content; `npm run test:coverage`: 1,776 tests pass; diff coverage 100%, C1 ok (16 changed files >= 80%). Lint, typecheck and format pass (run in a clean `npm ci` copy).
- `e2e/products.spec.ts` rewritten for three milestones: 27 of 27 pass. Deep links (`#pxp`, `#sxp`, `#ai-tutor`, `#iot`), the footer link, scene decoration, keyboard, focus return and scroll lock are covered.
- Full smoke + a11y: 83 passed, 94 failed. The same 94 fail on a clean build of `develop` (c5eb1aa), so they are not from this PR: the header pill overflows by 1 px since #116 added the mobile menu sheet (72 `header-language` cases), plus about, footer ridge, contact-on-phone, language-switch and one footer-link test. A fix PR follows.
- The layout-shift test (`walking the tour shifts the layout by less than 0.1`) is flaky under load (first cold run after a build): 8 of 8 pass on an idle machine, on both this branch and develop.

## UX checks

| Part | State or action | Input | Visible result | Timing | Checked |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Device screen | no real screenshot | any | wireframe, real feature names, `[Placeholder] screen` tag | n/a | unit test, screenshots |

Taken locally (desktop 1280x760, phone 390x844 at 2x); not attached.

author: aritr-codes
body:
Refs #128. This is the design step only. **The Kotlin follows in a separate change**, so this PR does not close the issue.

## Session Summary

**What changed.** This PR is the HTML-first design for one case. When a zine's `meta.json` is put back from its `.bak`, the maker should be told. Since D-116 (PR #127) the Shelf shows the repaired file's title, cover and folder, and nothing on screen says why they changed.

- **Library A37** (`docs/design/mockups/v21-library.html`) is frozen under delegation.
  - It adds one paper note directly under the My Shelf heading. The note stays until the maker presses **Got it** and is shown once per repair.
  - Rules A37.1–A37.12 cover where the note shows, its exact words, how it is dismissed, folders, several zines at once, large text at font scale 2 / 360dp, and what TalkBack hears.
  - Everything is appended (header paragraph, CSS block, caption, controls, closing `<script>`). No rule frozen on `main` was edited. The frozen `state` and `render` functions are wrapped, not changed.
- **The words (A37.3), after review:**
  - A zine whose name went back: “Letters to Gran” is called “Letters home” again
  - Any other single zine: Zinely repaired “Letters home”
  - The body: *A small file that holds its name, cover and folder was damaged, so Zinely used the copy from before the last change to them.* When the name went back, it adds: *You can rename it again.*
  - Several zines: "Zinely repaired {n} zines". All names are listed up to four. Past four, the first three are listed, then "and {k} more".
  - The button: **Got it**
  - The note never says "backup", because Backups on the same screen means library backups. It makes **no claim about the pages** (see RF-1 below).
- **ADR-134** is Accepted under the owner's delegation of 2026-10-12. The owner may overrule it. It decides the note and the build contract:
  - The read returns a sealed result: `Read`, `Restored` (a present, damaged file was replaced) or `BackupOnly` (a lone `.bak` after a failed repair, which raises no note).
  - The waiting note is kept per zine and is never copied by Duplicate, backups or restore.
  - The row is re-synced before the note shows.
  - TalkBack announces the note only when it arrives.
  - The scope is `meta.json` only.
- **D-120** has ten findings. Items 7–10 came from this review. Item 4 is out of scope: a `document.json` repaired from its own `.bak` is also silent, and it needs its own issue.
- **RESEARCH R29** cites:
  - the Material 2 banner (via Flutter's docs; Compose Material3 has no Banner)
  - Android's snackbar guidance
  - Office Document Recovery
  - the Microsoft and NN/g error-message guidelines
  - WCAG 4.1.3 (a web rule, applied to Android by analogy)
  - Flutter's live-region semantics

**Not changed:** no Kotlin, no goldens, no device. ADR-134's consequences list what the build owes.

## Review Package
- **Branch:** `feat/restored-notice-128`, from `origin/main` 3577e31.
- **Commits:**
  - d4f692d: A37
  - 8396a89: R29
  - fbfd474: ADR-134, D-120 and the index row
  - ffd75b0: wording fix
  - ac8e858: review reconciliation
- **ADRs:** ADR-134 (new). No other ADR's status was touched.
- **Docs:** `v21-library.html` A37, `RESEARCH.md` R29, `DECISIONS.md` ADR-134 and its index row, `V2-SPEC-DEFECTS.md` D-120.
- **Claims to verify:**
  - A `.bak` read can only be `BackupOnly` after a quarantine. `AtomicFileStore.write` copies the old file and then renames over it, so it never leaves the primary absent.
  - Re-syncing the row "whichever read found the repair" is implementable from a `readMetaOrNull` that is not `suspend`. The Kotlin may have to queue the re-sync.
  - The A37.10 "announced only on arrival" rule can be built in Compose without `announceForAccessibility`.
- **Known concerns:**
  - **R29 numbering:** lanes E and F also add research sections. Lane C merges after E (§6.4), so it will renumber R29 and fix the `#r29-…` link in ADR-134 if needed.
  - **Append conflict:** lane E appends A35 to the same mockup.
  - **Note size:** at font scale 2 / 360dp, the several-zine note fills most of the first screen and Got it sits below the fold under the dock. Every word shows, and the note scrolls away. The first-time-user pass should judge whether the screen still answers "Which zine do I want?".
  - **TalkBack:** it is unproven whether TalkBack speaks a live region that is added already filled (R29.4). The device pass has to find out.

## Independent review and reconciliation

Two Review Agents read the branch at `ffd75b0`. Both returned **GO WITH FIXES**.
- **Design and accessibility lens:** drove the mockup in headless Chromium and re-fetched five R29 sources.
- **Documents lens:** checked numbering, anchors and code claims, and re-fetched all seven sources.

A37 was frozen in this same PR and has not merged, so its rules were corrected in place. D-120 § Review holds the same table.

| ID | Class | Finding | Decision | Evidence / what changed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RF-1 | Required | "Its pages weren't touched" can be false in the scan that raises the note | **ACCEPT** | `reconcileLocked` → `syncRowFromDisk` → `documents.load` → `store.read(path, ::isLoadable)` silently restores `document.json` from its `.bak` (RoomProjectRepository.kt:1026, DocumentRepositoryImpl.kt:70). The sentence was removed from A37.3 and the script, and ADR-134 decision 2 states "no claim about the pages". I chose this over showing the sentence only when the document read was clean: the scan does not always load the document (a row that agrees is skipped), and tracking document repairs is D-120 item 4's scope |
| RF-2 | Required | A37.6 changes the words while the note is up, against A37.10 | **ACCEPT** | A37.10 and ADR-134 decision 6: the note is announced only when it arrives on a Shelf that already shows its zines. If it is already there when the Shelf opens, it is read in order. Any later change to the words is silent. A37.6 says the words follow at once, silently |
| F1 | Required | D-111 quoted only in part | **ACCEPT** | V2-SPEC-DEFECTS.md:7262-7264. ADR-134 decision 1 and A37.7 now quote "no badge, warning mark, card replacement or shelf-wide error state" in full and explain why: D-111 covers a zine that cannot be opened, while this note tells about a finished repair and is dismissed. The alternatives row was corrected |
| RI-1 / F2 | Recommended | "Once per repair" breaks on the quarantine path; a failed marker write is undefined | **ACCEPT** | AtomicFileStore.kt read(): if the repair fails, it deletes the target and returns the bytes it recovered. A37.6 and ADR-134 decisions 3–4 now say a repair counts only when a present, damaged file was replaced. A lone `.bak` read is `BackupOnly` and raises nothing. If the marker write fails, the note still shows for the current run, read from memory |
| RI-2 | Recommended | Re-announced each time the Shelf is re-entered | **ACCEPT** | Covered by RF-2's rule. The test ADR-134 owes: re-entering the Shelf, and a zine leaving the note, each make no announcement |
| RI-3 | Recommended | Give a way forward when the name went back | **PARTIALLY ACCEPT** | The one-zine form now adds "You can rename it again." The several-zine form names no remedy: each "(was …)" already carries the old name, and that form is already the long one (OB-3) |
| RI-4 | Recommended | "and 1 more" with four zines | **ACCEPT** | Up to four names are shown in full. Past four, three names and "and {k} more", with k ≥ 2. The prototype's button now raises five zines (probe: “Letters home” (was “Letters to Gran”), “Riso tests”, “Mum’s garden” and 2 more) |
| RI-5 | Recommended | The row holds the cover | **ACCEPT** | RoomProjectRepository.kt:1243-1246 compares coverSurface and coverStamp. Decision 3 and the alternatives row now say only the folder is not mirrored |
| F3 | Observation | {was} and the tile when the repair is found outside the scan | **ACCEPT** | ADR-134 decision 4: the row is re-synced before the note shows, whichever

author: tljohnsilver
body:
Block and error messages that a person who does not write code can act on: what happened, why, and the next step in one line.

**What changes**
- Credential files (`~/.aws/credentials`, SSH keys, `.netrc`, files named by `KUBECONFIG` and similar): the message names the file, says that zn treats it as holding secrets and why, and gives the way to use a value instead: `zn secret set NAME`, then `__ZN_NAME__` where the value goes. The old text read "reading a pattern too broad to check (...) is blocked" for some glob reasons.
- A secret used in the wrong place of a shell command (after the first command, with `$( )` or backticks, in a plain variable, after a reserved word, or with a quote that is not closed): one short explanation and one example. A secret in a plain variable now points to `zn run --secrets NAME -- <command>`.
- `zn run` with a command that is not allowed to use a secret: "`<cmd>` is not allowed to use NAME yet", then the command to allow it, without the internal `allowCommands` name.
- Hook failures: no more "hook error (error): <raw message> (fail-closed)". The agent reads that something went wrong in the zn hook, the action was blocked, and to try again or ask the user to run `zn hooks install`. A missing part of the installation gives the reinstall command.
- The text that replaces a tool output with instructions aimed at the agent keeps its `[zn-gate SECURITY BLOCKED]` prefix and now tells the agent not to act on it and to tell the user.

**Security**
- The way to let actions pass unchecked (`{"hooks": {"whenUnavailable": "allow"}}`) is no longer in any message the model reads: not in the stderr of a refused event (Claude Code and Codex show it to the model), not in Cursor's `agent_message`, not in the deny reason. In Claude Code it stays in the message to the user (`systemMessage`) when part of zn-gate is missing, and in the docs. New tests check both sides.

`POLICY_RULES_VERSION` is `2026-10-15.3` (the shell-command messages are part of the policy layer); the rules snapshot is updated. Tests that matched the old texts now match the new ones.

Not in this pull request: the PowerShell wrap messages, the MCP and Monitor notices, and the Python `GuardBlockError` text. They are next.


**After review:** hints use the same command form as the rest of zn (`npx -y zn-gate@<version> ...` when `zn` is not on the PATH); `zn run` says the allow step is the user's; a refused event no longer quotes the JSON parser's excerpt of stdin.

author: seefeldb
body: **Draft: with this change, a 12-member room stalls before the burst (see "Not done").** FabriChat sends from different members collided over the room's shared records, and in a 12×5 burst (commonfabric/labs#8901) sends ran out of retries and lost messages. This change makes each act write only documents of its own, joined to the room's lists by mergeable additions. ## What collided, and what changed - **Activity numbering.** `appendActivity` read and rewrote the `nextSeq` record and read the whole activity list on every act. Now an entry is keyed by its `at` and joined with `addUnique`. Its `seq` is its place in the order the store appends entries (`numberActivity()`), counted from `nextSeq`, which now records where numbering resumes after the dropped front. An obliteration clears the message's earlier entries in place, so no later `seq` moves. `recentActivity` is computed from the stored entries, and each row links the stored, `authored-by`-labeled entry as an optional `record`, so a sender still finds its own entry by its label (`ChatRoomActivity.md`). - **Expiry sweeps.** Every act read the `requests` and `usedTimes` lists whole to forget old entries. Expiry now runs in an event of its own, sent after each act and handled by a `commitSend` binding with `forgets: true`. A new handler would have changed the stored records' write policies, and with them their declared `ifc`. The update rehearsal showed that refusing rooms stored by the deployed release (`reconcile-commit-failed`). With the policies unchanged it passes. - **Recorded times.** The handler clock reads to the second, so every act in the same second started claiming times at the same nanosecond. A time taken from the clock now starts at a place in the tick derived from the sender's principal (`tickOffsetOf()`), within the first half of the tick, as `ChatRoomOutput.md` "Recorded times" allows. Each sender's own records keep their order. ## Tests - `fabrichat-send-burst-multi-runtime.test.ts` (new): 4 members × 4 messages at once. It asserts every message and `done` outcome in every runtime, and that no send was refused over a stale read of any room record. It is red on `main`'s pattern, where sends are refused over the numbering record, used times and other shared documents, and green here. - `logic.test.ts`: the clock offset. `room.test.tsx`: numbering read through `recentActivity`. `participant-chat.test.tsx`: `record` carries the sender's label. - `fabrichat-update-rehearsal.test.ts` finds a room's argument document through the piece's metadata, since `recentActivity` no longer aliases it. It passes over data from the deployed release. - `deno task cf test packages/patterns/fabrichat/` passed 267/267 before the final policy change. After it, the rerun got 16 files in (92 passed, 0 failed) before the process was killed on this machine, and `room`, `participant-chat` and `owner-obliteration` passed in full. `deno task check`, `deno task check-docs`, `deno task cfcheck --only fabrichat`, and `pattern-compat` (room, placement, adapter recorded; manager, home unchanged) are green. ## Not done 1. **A 12-member room stalls with this change.** On the benchmark branch at 12 members, setup and all 12 joins finish, then member 1's read of the room hits the harness's 120 s timeout. The unfixed branch gets past that step and loses messages in the burst instead. This change's first commit alone reproduces the stall, with or without `what` on the activity rows. Scheduler diagnostics show the runtimes repeatedly re-running the room's per-message computations, with no writes. My unconfirmed guess is the computed `recentActivity`, whose shared output document 12 runtimes keep rewriting while the list's order converges. **So the 12×5 burst has not passed verification with this change.** 2. **One runtime-side read remains.** Each send's commit carries a recursive read of the room's whole argument document (`/value`), which every other member's list addition overlaps. The room's handlers don't make it. A stack capture filtered to handler and pattern frames caught nothing, so it comes from the runtime around them. The new test leaves out only that read. Under load averages of 200–700 it still occasionally exhausts a send's retries at 4×4: one of four runs lost 2 sends. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: varun-jaiswal17
body:
### dnn: size conv and depthwise parallel tasks by amount of work

**Problem**

The new engine's convolution splits every layer into about 8 tasks per thread (256 on a 32-thread machine), whatever the size of the layer. Small layers get tiny tasks and still wake every thread. Depthwise convolution has the opposite problem: it creates one task per 8-channel block, so a large layer with few channels (for example 32 channels at 160×160 in YuNet) gets only 4 tasks while the other threads stay idle.

**Change**

- `computeSpatChunks()` takes the work per output pixel and no longer creates chunks smaller than `CONV_MIN_TASK_MACS` (32K multiply-adds).
- The seven blocked conv kernels pass `nstripes` = total multiply-adds / 32K to `parallel_for_`, so a small layer only wakes the threads it can keep busy. The SGEMM in 3rdparty/mlas sizes its threads the same way (`MLAS_SGEMM_THREAD_COMPLEXITY`), as does imgproc (`blend.cpp`).
- Depthwise convolution also splits each channel block's output rows into tasks of at least 32K multiply-adds. If a HAL implements `cv_hal_dnn_depthwise_conv32f` for the layer (checked with an empty range), the existing one-task-per-block split is kept.
- This also fixes a latent bug: for 3D depthwise convolution with a generic activation, the activation was applied at `out - planesize`, before the start of the output buffer.

**Performance**

i9-14900KS (8P + 16E cores, 32 threads).
ORT is pip onnxruntime 1.30.

author: kevinmingtarja
body:
## Problem

If a cluster runs a pod admission webhook with `failurePolicy: Fail` (Kueue's `mpod.kb.io` / `vpod.kb.io`, for example), and that webhook's service has no ready endpoints because its controller is crash-looping or restarting, the Kubernetes API server rejects every pod create with:

```
(500) Internal error occurred: failed calling webhook "mpod.kb.io": failed to call webhook: Post "https://kueue-webhook-service.kueue-system.svc:443/mutate--v1-pod?timeout=10s": no endpoints available for service "kueue-webhook-service"
```

SkyPilot then reported this as a capacity problem:

```
Failed to acquire resources in context <ctx> for {...}
```

Two things combined to produce that message:

1. `_create_namespaced_pod_with_retries` (`sky/provision/kubernetes/instance.py`) only special-cases AppArmor 422s, TPU errors and 409 "object is being deleted". A webhook 500 is re-raised as a raw `ApiException`.
2. In `RetryingVmProvisioner._retry_zones`, a raw `ApiException` falls into the generic `except Exception` branch. That branch keeps `last_error_reason` only for `InvalidCloudCredentials`, so `_insufficient_resources_msg` drops the webhook text.

As a result, users and their retry loops treated a cluster-side outage as "no capacity". Nothing in the output pointed at the webhook. These outages are also often intermittent: replicas come back for a few seconds between crashes, so a single failed create usually doesn't mean the next one will fail too.

## Change

- New `_create_namespaced_pod_retrying_webhook_errors`. On a 500 whose message matches `failed calling webhook "<name>"`, it retries the create with jittered exponential backoff (2s initial, 10s cap) for up to 60s.
  - A rejected create is not persisted, so each retry costs one API server call.
  - Every other error is re-raised unchanged into the existing handling.
- When the retry budget runs out, it raises `config_lib.KubernetesError`. The message names the webhook and the context, says it is a webhook-service problem rather than a lack of resources, and includes the API server's message.
- The failover loop's existing `except config_lib.KubernetesError` branch already sets `last_error_reason = str(e)`, so the failover summary now shows `Reason: Pod creation in context '<ctx>' was rejected because admission webhook 'mpod.kb.io' could not be called ...`. The failover/blocklist behaviour for the context is unchanged.
- The 409 and AppArmor retry paths still call `create_namespaced_pod` directly. A webhook failure on those second attempts surfaces as before.

## Tested

- [x] New unit tests in `tests/unit_tests/kubernetes/test_provision.py::TestCreatePodWebhookUnavailable` (fake `ApiException`s and a fake clock):
  - two webhook 500s followed by a success returns the pod after 2 sleeps;
  - a persistent webhook 500 raises `KubernetesError` naming the webhook and context, with `insufficent_resources=None`, and total sleep within the 60s budget;
  - a non-webhook 500 is re-raised immediately with no retry;
  - the resulting reason, rendered through `_insufficient_resources_msg` and `_format_provision_failure_blocks`, contains `Reason: Pod creation in context 'ctx-a'` and the webhook name, and no `Hint:`.
- [x] The neighbouring suites (`TestCreatePodFinalizerHandling`, `TestFullPipeline`, `TestProvisionFailureBlocks`) pass. In the full file, 5 `TestGetPodDeletionReason` tests fail; they fail the same way on unmodified `master` (3ac48e370).
- [ ] Not yet run against a real cluster with an unreachable webhook (e.g. scale a test webhook's backing deployment to 0 and `sky launch`).

author: anandanmol1010
body:
## Description

`urunit.conf` mixed framing and data on newlines, so a newline inside env vars, workdir, block mountpoints or FreeBSD args spilled over and corrupted the config (#1068).

Keep section markers (`UES/UEE`, `UCS/UCE`, `UBS/UBE`, `UNS/UNE`, `PAD`) newline-terminated, but terminate every value record with NUL instead of newline. NUL cannot appear in valid env vars, paths or args (execve forbids it), so the separator can never occur inside a value and newlines stay data. Only NUL is now rejected via `validateUrunitValue()`.

Writers updated: `Linux.buildUrunitConfig()` + `FreeBSD.buildUrunitConfig()` (incl. `ARV:` and Net `IP/GW/MSK`). Matching `urunit` reader change needed to split values on `\0` instead of `\n`.

body:
Authorized consultants can create a PREPARING project for a NEW or EXISTING customer, submit the first ZIP and optional note, and recover the original creation request and intake after response loss, refresh or relogin. The live React/BFF/Core journey uses actual IP/EP/IG owning services and exposes WAITING_CAPABILITY when TE/Runner capability is unavailable.

Changes:

- Closed preparation payload/result/event schemas, typed references, generated artifacts, standalone preparation and TE mapping fixtures, and 258 registered operations while preserving the frozen 200-operation compatibility baseline.
- Explicit IP admission/enrollment, independently authorized scoped SERVICE bootstrap, membership materialization and seven separate exact creator Grants. Login or Enterprise access does not confer Project access.
- EP NEW/EXISTING creation, PREPARING Project/ScopeClaim and receipts, immutable original commands and safe continuation. Historical dependency withdrawal preserves committed facts as STALE and blocks new writes.
- IG immutable ZIP/note/ANALYZE intent, fixed five-minute encrypted tickets, bounded streaming, one restart with aggregate-version CAS and generation fencing, retained original objects, strict ZIP/DOCX validation and actual EP source/security/integrity/acceptance receipts.
- Atomic manifest/Receipt/Outbox, EP Inbox and unique original-intake handoff/source snapshot. Queries remain read-only; unavailable downstream capabilities cannot manufacture Task, Run or report facts.
- Finite production routes and explicit deployment configuration, relogin/original-request recovery, authorized custody reads, same-file restart and session/scope fencing. Production does not load development fixtures.

Review comments:

- R1 is addressed by the complete owning-service and production journey above, replacing the initial ticket-only implementation.
- R2 is addressed by one namespace-aware SAX parser for the three OOXML parts. Structural evidence comes from actual elements; malformed XML, comment impersonation, duplicate attributes/expanded names, invalid character references, DTD/external entities and padded namespace URIs are rejected within the existing time/memory budgets. The parser dependency is pinned to `saxes@6.0.0` and `xmlchars@2.2.0`. The upstream project is archived; this limitation remains explicit for technical review.
- The latest CI failure exposed an upload-completion gap: owner facts could be committed while the HTTP response was still unfinished. The exact ZIP proxy now uses the existing five-minute upload budget instead of the generic 15-second socket inactivity timeout, and the browser consumes the successful response body before treating transport as complete. Existing byte/idle/total limits remain enforced at their owning boundaries.
- Regression coverage now includes an actual HTTP upstream that responds after 16 seconds, delayed/interrupted 200 response bodies, and the exact browser PUT returning a complete 200 before asserting STAGED/READY, manifest and original-intake handoff. Cleanup budgets are unchanged; active requests are not force-closed.
- The follow-up browser correction waits for the NEW/restart intake's exact PUT response before checking the UI. author: jaredmaxey
body:
Implements the owner's Node-support decision (2026-10-14): package-specific minimums. Signing and report now declare the Node 20+ runtime they already required, and Node 18 stays declared wherever it works.

**Reproduced first** (readiness assessment §4, #338):
- **N-1, report.** `@uwmd/report`'s `playwright-core ^1.49.0` resolves to 1.64.x, which requires Node 20. On Node 18.0.0 and 18.20.8 it exits 1 before any output, even with `--format html`.
- **N-2, signing.** On Node 18.20.8, `@uwmd/signing` fails `sign-document` and `verify --document-signature` with `SIG_NO_CRYPTO`, because there is no global Web Crypto without a flag. The error message claimed Node 18.4 was enough.

**Change**
- `engines.node` is now `>=20.0.0` in `@uwmd/signing` (was `>=18.4.0`) and `@uwmd/report` (was `>=18.0.0`). The workspace entries in `package-lock.json` follow.
- **Unchanged at `>=18.0.0`:** verify, core, CLI, batch, lake and Excel. All of them were re-run on Node 18.0.0 and 18.20.8.
- **`SIG_NO_CRYPTO`** now says "needs Node 20 or later, or a browser". The wrong comment in `algorithms.ts` and the one in `errors.ts` are corrected. A new `algorithms.test.ts` pins the error code and the message.
- **Docs:** the signing README, the report README (new Requirements section), wiki 08, wiki 11 and a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry.

**Versioning.** Dropping a declared runtime is breaking for these two 0.x packages ("a breaking change to a 0.x package moves its minor", CHANGELOG precedent). So the release preparation moves signing to 0.6.0 and report to 0.9.0. This PR changes no versions.

**Validation**
- build, `typecheck:tests`, Biome;
- signing tests, 122/122;
- `verify-lockfile`, `verify-packages`, `release:check`, `verify-versions`, `verify-release`, `verify-indexes`;
- the new message checked on Node 18.20.8.

author: victorpurmar
body:
## What

On the Overview, clicking the newest bar of the score history could still show "viewing the run of … · back to latest". The back button then pointed at a run the chart doesn't show.

**Cause:** a cancelled or failed run is listed in `availableRuns`, but it is never a history point. The server's `scoring_view.select_trend_runs` keeps only done and running runs. The Overview's "latest" was the newest run that isn't running, so a newer cancelled run (here, a nightly stopped by SIGTERM) became "latest". The newest bar then read as a past run.

**Fix:** a new `latestHistoryRunId` in `models/runRules.js` returns the newest done run, mirroring the server rule. `overviewAsOf` and `overviewPastRun` both use it. Picking an older run, including a cancelled one from the run navigator, still shows the past-run note as before.

## Checks
- `npm test`, `npm run test:ui`, all 10 `lint:*` scripts, `tests/tools`. The change is UI-only, so I did not rerun the full Python suite.
- New tests: a cancelled run newer than the last done run (the newest done run reads as today, and back goes to it), plus the helper itself. The as-of test fails on the old rule.
- Diff-mode self-eval: 0 violations.

author: abdul-hamid-achik
body:
- **fix(ios): clamp pill corner radii and paint the host with the app background**
- **fix(ios): expose app views to accessibility and give fetch a Headers object**
- **chore: changeset for the iOS radius, safe-area, accessibility and fetch fixes**
- **fix(ios): SVG crash on unknown devices, keyboard scroll, contentContainerStyle**
- **chore(contracts): drop the fixed iOS VScrollView contentContainerStyle gap**
- **feat(iap): signed transactions, appAccountToken and manage subscriptions**
- **fix(ios): keep fetch and timer callbacks alive across GC; VInput padding**
- **fix(macos,shared): keep fetch and timer callbacks alive across GC**
- **feat(audio): recording input level on iOS; speaker route while recording**
- **fix(ios): repaint the host background on theme switches**

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes core JS polyfill retention and IAP transaction payloads used for server verification, plus many iOS layout/accessibility paths that could affect existing apps.
> 
> **Overview**
> Introduces **`JSCallbackRegistry`** so pending `fetch` resolve/reject handlers and `setTimeout`/`setInterval` callbacks stay on the JS heap (iOS, macOS, shared polyfills), fixing intermittent hangs when the GC freed `JSManagedValue`-backed callbacks. **`fetch`** responses now expose a **`Headers`-like** `response.headers` with case-insensitive `get()`.
> 
> **iOS native:** clamps pill **`borderRadius`** so clipped views don’t vanish; mirrors the app root **`backgroundColor`** on the host behind the safe area (including on theme-only style updates); stops null accessibility props from hiding VoiceOver subtrees; **`VInput`** applies padding to the editor; **`VKeyboardAvoiding`** scrolls the focused field into view; **`VScrollView`** honors **`contentContainerStyle`** / `flexGrow`; **`<VSVG>`** primes SVGKit to avoid Debug crashes on unknown devices.
> 
> **`useAudio`:** optional **`metering`** with `recordingLevel`, `onRecordingLevel`, and `audio:recordingLevel`; recording uses **`defaultToSpeaker`** and returns to playback routing when recording stops.
> 
> **`useIAP`:** iOS transactions include **`jwsRepresentation`**, **`appAccountToken`**, **`environment`**, and **`revoked`** updates; **`purchase(sku, { appAccountToken })`** and **`showManageSubscriptions()`** (Play Store on Android). Docs and contract baseline updated accordingly.

author: codexlocal101-rgb
body:
## 무엇을 바꿨나 — 한 줄

메모를 밀어 지울 때 **저장이 실패하면, 그 알림을 목록 끝이 아니라 «되돌리기» 토스트 자리(화면 아래 고정 영역)에 띄운다** — 목록이 길어도 항상 보인다. 함께, 되돌리기 쪽 저장 실패와 «한 메모의 재시도가 다른 메모의 되돌리기를 끊는» 순서를 시험으로 고정했다. 데이터 계층(`src/storage/`)·PRD 문면(`spec/`)은 **0줄**.

- **브랜치** `hyk304-delete-undo-ui-2` · **커밋** 2개 — `36abdb2`(1R 고정 위치 + 고정 칸) · `8c5056cd838aff9e76f693c2533729f9cf42ee84`(2R 결선 고정 · 교차오염 수리 · HEAD)
- **base** `main` `1fac89456ce9a1f9d5df1a318d65fada080c1792`(= `git merge-base origin/main HEAD` · PR #37 병합판) · 리베이스 0 · 스택 0
- **기여** `6 files changed, 744 insertions(+), 73 deletions(-)` — 제품 4(`public/index.html` +21 · `src/editor/app.mjs` +4 · `memo-list-mount.mjs` · `memo-list-view.mjs`) + 시험 2(`test/editor/memo-list-delete-undo.test.mjs` · `test/editor/app-wiring.test.mjs`)

### 왜

PR #37(삭제 되돌리기 UI) 검토가 남긴 후속: 저장 실패 알림이 목록 **끝**에 붙어, 긴 목록에서는 화면 밖(카드 31장 표본 top 2723px)으로 나갔다. ⭐**책임자 결정(2026-10-14 · 한용이 뒤집을 수 있음)** = 위치는 «되돌리기 토스트 자리」 고정 · 토스트가 떠 있으면 실패 표시가 그 자리를 대신하고 되돌리기 버튼은 유지.

### 어떻게

1. **1R `36abdb2`** — `#list-delete-toast` 안에 `#list-save-error-button` 추가 · 토스트 컨트롤러가 «되돌리기(active)」와 «실패(errorState · 메모 id 로 범위)」 두 상태를 조합해 표시 · 목록 끝 append(`renderSaveError`) 제거 · 되돌리기 쪽 저장 실패 고정 칸 · 39/40px 경계 · 출하 CSS 칸 강인화(주석·재선언) · `graceMs` 전달 고정 · 오류 중복 방지 · 문구 리터럴 칸.
2. **2R `8c5056c`** — 검토 1R 의 P2 2건 수리: ⓐ 결선 고정 칸(실물 부팅 + 저장 1회 강제 실패 → 실패 버튼 표시 · 배선 id 목록에 새 요소 2개) ⓑ 되돌리기 «재시도」가 **자기 메모의 되돌리기일 때만** 토스트를 떼고 타이머를 끈다(`isActiveUndo(id)` 조건 1줄) — 전에는 다른 메모(B)의 살아 있는 되돌리기를 끊어 B 가 7초 뒤 지워졌다 + 그 순서 고정 칸 · 주석 정정(코드와 반대였음).

### 증거

- ⭐**검토 2R(Opus 5.5) approved** — P1 0 · P2 0 · P3 1:
  - ⭐**헤드리스 Chrome 출하 판 2표본**(8c5056c 의 `public/index.html` 바이트 사본 + 실제 `app.mjs` 번들 · 390×844 모바일 에뮬레이션 · 각 1회): ① 카드 31장 · 한 화면 밖 29번째 카드 스와이프 + 저장 1회 강제 실패 → 실패 버튼 **top 698 / bottom 742(뷰포트 844) · 토스트 상자 안** ② A 되돌리기 실패 → B 스와이프 성공 → A 재시도 → **A 복원 · B 되돌리기 버튼 생존 · B 숨김 타이머 미해제(`clearTimeout` 0건)** → B 되돌리기 → A·B·C 모두 복원 · `unhandledrejection` 0. ⚠️**실기기 아님**.
  - 프로덕션 파일 제자리 변이 12(전부 바이트 복원): 결선 삭제 S4·S5·S6 · 가드 제거 H1 · 자기 변이 M1·M2·M5·M6 · 위치 W1 · catch W3 → 전부 빨강(M3 = 등가 변이 · M4 → 아래 남은 것 1).
  - 범위: `spec/` · `src/storage/` 0(`memo-lifecycle.mjs` sha256 = base 판) · 기존 칸 이름 변경·삭제 0 · prettier 재포맷의 기존 단언 변경 0.
- 검토 1R(Opus 5.5) approved(P1 0 · P2 2 · P3 5) → 그 P2 2건을 2R 로 닫음 · 1R 헤드리스 위치 표본(top 698/742)과 2R 표본 일치.
- `npm test` — tests 2417 / pass 2417 / fail 0(작성 2R · 검토 2R 각 1회) · `quality-check --mode ci --base-sha 1fac894` clean.

## ⚠️ 남은 것 — 숨기지 않고 적는다

1. **(P3-1 · 검토 2R)** «재시도가 자기 것일 때만 **타이머**를 끈다」 절반을 고정하는 칸이 없다 — 그 줄을 조건 밖으로 빼는 변이(M4)가 초록. 지금 출하 코드는 맞다(헤드리스 표본 2 에서 B 타이머 미해제). 다음 조각에서 «A 재시도 뒤 시계를 7초 진행 → B 토스트 숨김」 1칸으로 닫는다.
2. **(검토 1R P3-1 · 등재)** 실패 표시 슬롯이 하나다 — A 의 **되돌리기** 실패가 다른 메모 C 의 실패에 덮이면 A 의 재시도 경로가 화면에서 사라져 A 가 숨은 채 남는다(데이터 손실은 아님). 후속 후보 «시작 시 유예 만료분 정리 + restore 실패 복구」에 이 순서를 넣었다.
3. **해석 ⓐ = 책임자 결정(2026-10-15 09:2x · 한용이 뒤집을 수 있음)**: «되돌리기 버튼은 유지」는 «다른 메모의 살아 있는 되돌리기」를 말한다. A **자신의** 되돌리기 저장이 실패하면 실패 버튼(재시도 = 복원)만 보이고 «되돌리기」 버튼은 숨는다(한 버튼 = 한 동작).
4. 오류 표시 중복(W8)은 작성·검토 모두 재지 않았다. 두 버튼(실패 · 되돌리기)이 한 토스트에 나란히 뜰 때의 글자 잘림·배치는 판정하지 않았다.
5. ⛔**실기기(Android Chrome · iOS Safari) 미확인** — 헤드리스 결과로 «휴대폰에서 된다」고 말하지 않는다. 한용 육안(실기기 저장 실패 재현은 어려움 — 위치 확인은 병합 조건 아님).
6. **(범위 밖 · 데이터 계층 기존 동작)** 7초 안에 앱을 닫으면 메모가 숨은 채 남는다 — PR #37 과 같은 갈래 · 후속 후보.

author: vvoytovych
body:
When a Domain loses DNS authority for a single check, Gateway DNS deletes the record set of every hostname on it. It does so although the gateway still claims them. One wrong nameserver answer did that to four records on staging (#315). This keeps a claimed hostname's record set for a configurable period instead, and deletes it only if authority does not come back.

| Change | Where |
|---|---|
| A claimed hostname whose verified Domain has a DNSZone but no authority keeps its existing record set unchanged. The first check stamps it `dns.datumapis.com/authority-missing-since`. A more specific Domain that is not verified still deletes at once, as before | `gateway_dns_controller.go` |
| Authority back removes the stamp. A stamp older than `gateway.dnsAuthorityLossGracePeriod` (default `48h`) lets garbage collection delete the record set, as before | `gateway_dns_controller.go`, `config.go` |
| The gateway rechecks when the earliest wait ends, without holding up its status or routes | `gateway_controller.go` |
| The `DNSAuthorityMissing` message says until when the record is kept. The agent docs and the reason catalog say the same | `docs/agent/`, `internal/agent/catalog.go` |

- A hostname the gateway no longer claims is deleted at once, stamped or not (#283). So is every record set of a deleted gateway, HTTPProxy, Domain or DNSZone.
- cloud-portal's delete preview reads `DNSAuthorityMissing` as "no record". So during the wait it leaves out of its count a record that does exist, and that does go with the load balancer.
- The stamp lives on the record set, as `NetworkPresence` keeps `unclaimed-since`, so a restart neither restarts nor skips the wait. An unreadable stamp restarts it.
- Cloudflare also waits: a zone whose Cloudflare nameservers are gone goes to Moved, and a free zone is deleted 7 days later ([zone status](https://developers.cloudflare.com/dns/zone-setups/reference/domain-status/)). We default to 48 hours.
- 48 hours outlasts one daily nameserver refresh with its jitter, about 29 hours. Zero keeps the earlier behaviour.
- The no-authority message moved into `authorityMissingMessage`, and the search for a user's conflicting record into `userRecordConflict`. The two requeue choices moved into `earliestRequeue`. So `ensureDNSRecordSets` and `ensureDownstreamGateway` come out simpler than before.

## Test plan

- [x] `go test ./internal/config/ ./internal/controller/... ./internal/agent/...`
- [x] `TestDNSAuthorityHold_*`. Each test fails with a defect planted in the code it covers.
  - a blip keeps the record set and stamps it once
  - authority back removes the stamp, also while a user's record holds the hostname
  - a stamp past the period deletes, and the gateway's reconcile requeues for that moment
  - a removed hostname deletes at once
  - a deleted gateway, Domain or DNSZone deletes at once
  - a restart neither restarts nor skips the wait
  - an unreadable stamp restarts it
  - a changed period moves the deadline, zero included
  - a failed stamp deletes nothing
  - nothing is created where no record set exists
  - a record set another manager owns is never stamped
  - concurrent passes keep one stamp, stamped or not at the start (`-race`)
- [x] On Milo's own API server and garbage collector, in kind. On `main` one blip deletes the record set. With this change:
  - a blip keeps it
  - recovery clears the stamp, also while a user's record holds the hostname
  - a stamp past a short period deletes it
  - deleting the gateway while stamped lets the garbage collector take it
- [x] `make generate`, and `golangci-lint run --new-from-rev=origin/main` reports nothing new

Related to #315

Aplica o acabamento aprovado após a prévia: entrada de página em 150 ms, resposta discreta dos botões e respeito ao movimento reduzido do sistema. Mantém cores, fontes, organização e foco da navegação; não adiciona esperas ao fluxo.

Os cadastros faciais da identidade e da conta mostram as cinco capturas. A etapa só avança depois de produzir a foto; a análise do servidor continua decidindo se o cadastro foi aceito. Falha de câmera preserva a contagem real; nova tentativa, cancelamento e logout limpam o indicador.

- [x] Falha de captura sem avanço indevido.
- [x] Navegação e foco com e sem movimento reduzido.
- [x] Dois cadastros conferidos em 1440 px/claro e 390 px/escuro, sem rolagem horizontal.

- [x] Proposta visual autorizada pelo responsável após a comparação da prévia.
- [x] Sem alteração de banco, consentimento, reconhecimento, limites faciais ou atuação da porta.
- [x] Sem novas dependências ou imagens pessoais versionadas.
- [x] Mantém os aceites reais de câmera e avaliação facial para o grupo.
- [x] Notion e Figma fora desta publicação.

author: areumz
body:
## Contract update — 아티스트 페이지 섹션(section) 반영 · 곡 수 규칙 · 허용 Origin 안내

on-stage 설계 중 들어온 계약 갱신 요청(C1~C5, C7, C8)을 반영한다. `contracts/`와 서버 동작을 함께 갱신하며, on-stage 코드는 열지 않았다. C6(전체 공연 읽기 엔드포인트)는 API 작업 완료 후 뒷단계에서 추가할 예정.

설계 [`docs/design.md`](https://github.com/areumz/stage-one-tour-guide-agent/blob/feature/contract-update-section/docs/design.md) §4·§5·§14.3,
계약 [`contracts/ui_actions.md`](https://github.com/areumz/stage-one-tour-guide-agent/blob/feature/contract-update-section/contracts/ui_actions.md),
인수인계 [`docs/handoff-onstage.md`](https://github.com/areumz/stage-one-tour-guide-agent/blob/feature/contract-update-section/docs/handoff-onstage.md).

**공개 배포 불가**: 1단계와 같이 L3 분류기·출력 검사(`retract`)가 없다. 3단계 통과 전에는 공개 배포하지 않는다.

### 변경 사항

- `contracts/guide_events.py` — `ViewContext.section`(`hero`/`tour`/`album`/`gallery`, 선택, `view="tour"`일 때만 의미)과 `OpenTour.section`(같은 값, 생략하면 on-stage는 `tour`로 해석). 요청 쪽 모르는 `section` 값은 거절하지 않고 `None`으로 취급
- `contracts/fixtures/guide_events_sample.json` — `section`이 있는/없는 요청 샘플(`requests`), `openTour` 이벤트 샘플(`success_open_tour`, `success_open_tour_section`) 추가. 기존 `success`/`error` 스트림은 그대로
- `src/tour_guide/agent.py` — 서버 중복 `openTour` 필터를 현재 section 기준으로 갱신, 프롬프트의 현재 화면 표기에 section 포함(`tour/aurora/album`), 곡 수 규칙 한 줄과 `getArtist` 도구 설명 갱신
- `src/tour_guide/tools.py` — `getArtist`가 `totalTracks`(= `stats.tracks`)와 `featuredTracks`(= `tracks[]` 제목)를 구분해 반환
- `tests/` — 계약·서버 필터·화면 표기·곡 수·요청 검증 테스트와 LLM 마커 테스트 2개 추가(총 126개 + `llm` 10개)
- `contracts/ui_actions.md`, `README.md`, `artist_context.md`, `docs/design.md`, `docs/handoff-onstage.md`, `.env.example` — 계약 갱신 내용 반영

### 주요 결정

- 중복 필터: `view=tour`이고 `slug`가 같으며 현재 `section`이 `tour`이거나 **없을 때만** `openTour`를 거른다. `hero`/`album`/`gallery`를 보는 중이면 보내서 on-stage가 투어 섹션으로 스크롤한다. 섹션을 모르면 이전 동작을 유지한다
- 에이전트가 보내는 `openTour.section`은 당분간 계속 생략한다(C2). 값을 모를 때 on-stage로 내보내지 않도록 이 쪽은 엄격하게 둔다
- 요청의 모르는 `section`은 무시한다(`view`·`slug`는 엄격). on-stage가 섹션을 추가해도 채팅이 422로 깨지지 않게 하기 위함
- 곡 수는 도시와 같은 규칙: "몇 곡"은 `totalTracks`, 곡 목록은 "대표 곡"이라고 밝힌다. 실제 응답에서 `stats.tracks`와 `tracks[]`가 다름(aurora 8 vs 4)
- C7은 기본값을 바꾸지 않고 `.env.example`에 운영 도메인 추가 예시만 기록한다. 로컬 개발 기본 허용 범위를 넓히지 않기 위함. 프리뷰 도메인 패턴은 on-stage가 정해 전달

### C8 확인 결과

- 모르는 필드(`color`, `gallery`, `shader` 등)는 거부하지 않고 **무시**한다(실제 응답 fixture 6명 모두 파싱)
- `stats.tracks`는 에이전트가 쓰지 않던 값이었고, 위 곡 수 규칙으로 정리했다

### 알려진 한계

- 프롬프트 수준 규칙이라 확률적이다. LLM 테스트 3회 중 `test_korean_question_calls_tool_and_answers`가 2회 실패했다(아래 검증)

author: snowfoxsean
body:
The bench repo is to hold no scripts: everything operational is a `silverquillm` command, and analysis of runs lives in the Results Repo (#208 runbook grilling). This moves the 21 files under `scripts/` accordingly.

**Commands.** The benchmark-input builders and the maintenance and qualification tools move into `silverquillm/tools/` and run as four command groups:

- `silverquillm data fetch-hob-set | fetch-fra-set | card-id-map | token-id-map | download-replays`
- `silverquillm build fra-hard | port-from-known-best | printed-classes | fdn-specs | audited-stubs`
- `silverquillm audit check-promotion | printed-identity`
- `silverquillm qualify claude-telemetry | codex-telemetry`

Each command hands its arguments to the tool's own `main(argv)` parser, so flags, help text and exit status are the tool's, unchanged. Modules load only when their command runs, and every checkout-based tool takes the checkout it reads and writes from `silverquillm.tools.REPO_ROOT`, the checkout the package is imported from (the promotion gate's `main(repo_root=...)` override stays for its tests). `oracle_support.py` becomes a package module. Tools that took no arguments gained a `--help`; `build_token_id_map` now parses its optional corpus argument instead of reading `sys.argv`. `download_replays` keeps `curl_cffi` optional and says so when it is missing. The Codex qualification still runs itself inside the candidate image by path, now from `silverquillm/tools/`.

**Analyses moved out.** `harvest_validated_results.py`, `mine_promotion_candidates.py`, `validated_results_to_csv.py` and `validate_harvest_sos_results.py`, with their 11 test files, move to the Results Repo's `scripts/legacy/` in the companion PR, which then removes the two with no users (`validated_results_to_csv.py`, `validate_harvest_sos_results.py`) and marks the harvester and miner as deprecated legacy tools kept to reproduce the legacy SOS analyses; the docs here say the same. Their output on this host's legacy tree is identical before and after the move (harvest rows apart from the timestamp, miner text, CSV). The repo-local test-investigation skill and the Audited Test specs now point there.

**Deleted.** `port_foundations_to_fdn.py`, a one-off port with no references.

**The triage tool.** `scripts/triage_divergences.py` moves to `silverquillm/triage_divergences.py` and runs as `silverquillm replay triage`, so `scripts/` is gone. It is a grading input, so its bytes are unchanged and the grader still stages it at the grading-root path `scripts/triage_divergences.py`, the path its fingerprint is keyed by: no benchmark's grading-inputs digest changes (checked before and after for all five).

Generated-file markers (`Generated by scripts/generate_audited_stubs.py`, the printed-abilities region header) keep their text, since they are part of committed Workspaces and changing them would rewrite those files.

Closes #222. Stacked on #228. Companion: snowfoxbuilds/bench-results#21.

Tests: the full suite passes (5055 passed, 6 skipped) before rebasing onto #228's head fec31e53; the touched suites pass after it (396 passed). `tests/test_check_promotion_command.py` runs `silverquillm audit check-promotion` through the CLI with the root unpatched: a valid smoke candidate passes all three checks from an unrelated directory and edits nothing; a missing benchmark, a failing candidate and a Released benchmark exit non-zero. With the promotion and triage tests: 54 passed.

A new **Rental Listings** page (`js/rentals.js`) for the `rental_properties` that owners post on keys99.com.

author: soch-ia
body:
Fixes #127

A composed `é` and an `e` followed by a combining accent look identical but were treated as different names, so `student add n/José` could create two visually identical students.

- `Name` now stores its value in Unicode NFC form, and the 50-character limit is checked on that form.
- Because every `Name` is composed, lookup, duplicate detection, display and the saved data all use one spelling.
- A data file containing both spellings is rejected as a duplicate on load (existing duplicate-student check).
- `find` composes its keywords, so a decomposed keyword still matches.

Verification:
- `./gradlew check` passed.
- New tests: composed/decomposed names are equal and the same name; length limit counted after composition; `find` with a decomposed keyword; loading a file with both spellings fails.
- Manual check with the JAR: adding `José` composed then decomposed gives the duplicate-student error, and `student view` / `find` with the decomposed spelling find the composed student.

author: eom-tae-in
body:
Closes #24

## 무엇을 만들었나

이후 모든 주최 관리 기능이 쓸 공통 토대 — 운영진 권한 확인과 운영진 조작 기록 — 를 만들었다.
- **권한 확인** `CheckStaffPermissionUseCase.check` → `StaffPermissionResult`: 현재 소속 → 역할(권한 표) → 주최자 활동 순서로 보고 거부는 403. 소속을 먼저 봐서 바깥 사람에게는 주최자 상태가 드러나지 않고, 없는 주최자도 `NOT_ORGANIZER_STAFF`로 같게 답해 존재를 숨김. 다른 주최자 운영진·나간 운영진·운영자의 소유자 전용 일은 막힘
- **바꿔치기 막기**: 경로의 주최자 id로 소속을 확인하고, 자원이 그 주최자 것인지 `covers`로 판정(다른 주최자 자원이면 없는 것으로)
- **경로 규약** `/api/organizer/organizers/{organizerId}/**` + `@CurrentStaff ActingStaff`: 로그인 운영진과 경로 주최자 id를 Command로 넘김(401/403/400 구분, OpenAPI에 경로 파라미터)
- **운영진 조작 기록** `RecordStaffOperationUseCase.record`(MANDATORY — 조작과 같은 트랜잭션에서만, 실패하면 기록도 되돌림): 주최자·운영진·시각·조작 종류(`StaffAction`)·그때의 역할·대상·요약
- **주최자 이력 조회** `GetStaffOperationHistoryUseCase`: 최근 것부터, id로 이어 보기, 닉네임·이름 함께(관리자 주최자 상세 API는 #129)

## 근거 문서

- docs/01-accounts.md 권한 두 가지 표, 운영진 조작 기록
- docs/13-ia.md 주최 영역, 관리자 주최자 상세
- docs/16-architecture.md:73 포트 입출력은 Command/Result

## 구조

- domain: `domain/organizer` StaffPermission(check·covers), StaffOperationRecord, StaffOperationTargetKind
- application (port/in · port/out · service): port/in ActingStaff, CheckStaffPermission*, `StaffPermissionResult`, RecordStaffOperation*, GetStaffOperationHistory*; port/out StaffOperationRecordRepository, StaffOperationHistoryQueryPort(조회 DTO `organizer/query`); service 3개(도메인 StaffPermission은 서비스 안에서만)
- 어댑터 (app-* · infra-*): app-api `security/CurrentStaff` + 해석기; infra-persistence 저장·이력 조회 어댑터
- 마이그레이션: `V11__staff_operation_record.sql` — 운영진 조작 기록 + `(organizer_id, id)` 색인

## 어떻게 확인했나

```
./gradlew build --rerun-tasks   → BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 2,059개 통과, 건너뜀 271(Testcontainers, 로컬 Docker 꺼짐) → CI에서 건너뜀 0 확인 예정
  StaffPermissionTest: StaffAction 전체 × 역할 54개 / CurrentStaffTest 16개(401/403/400)
  StaffPermissionIntegrationTest(PostgreSQL, 시험용 컨트롤러·서비스): 운영자의 소유자 전용 일 403, 다른 주최자 운영진 403, 기록 남음, 주최자 id 바꿔치기, 실패 시 기록 되돌림
  RecordStaffOperationService: 트랜잭션 밖 호출은 막힘(프록시 테스트)
커밋 5개 각각 빌드 통과
verifier 1차: 통과 + 규칙 위반 1건(유스케이스가 도메인 객체를 그대로 반환 — docs/16:73) → StaffPermissionResult로 감쌈
verifier 2차: 통과
```

## 리뷰 포인트

- "주최자가 활동 중이 아님"은 권한 확인에서 **403**(이슈 본문대로), 기존 주최자 정보 변경에서는 409로 갈린다. 화면이 받는 code(`ORGANIZER_NOT_ACTIVE`)는 같다 → 통일 여부는 #135
- **#135로 올린 것**: 이력 표기의 이름이 실명인지 닉네임인지(둘 다 담음), 운영진 조작 기록 보관 기간 미정(지우지 않음), 경로 규약
- 정지 1~3단계에서 막히는 일은 정지 기능(#122~#124)이 판단하도록 `StaffPermission` Javadoc에 적어 둠
- 이후 주최 관리 서비스는 `check` → `covers`로 자원 거름(다른 주최자 것이면 404) → 조작 → `record` 순서. 표 밖 조작(나가기·초대 수락 등)은 그 이슈에서 `StaffAction`에 더함

## 체크리스트

- [x] 구조 규칙 테스트(ArchitectureTest) 통과
- [x] 이미 적용된 마이그레이션 수정 없음 (새 파일 V11)
- [x] 비밀값 커밋 없음
- [ ] 문서와 다른 판단 없음 — 문서에 없는 판단을 질문 이슈 #135에 올림

author: inumberx
body:
Refs #115(作業プランの手順5a)

## 概要

手順5を2つに分けたうちの前半です。`app.css` の `base` レイヤーと `app/ui/` の既存部品を、テンプレート(generalview)由来の値から `develop`(sugidama)の見た目に揃え、#115 の手順5に積んでいた不具合をまとめて直しました。ヘッダー・フッター・カードなどの共通部品は 5b で移植します。

## 変更内容

### `app.css` の `base` レイヤー

`develop` の `cssVariables.css.ts` と `root.css.ts` を移しました。`reset` レイヤー(ress 6.0.0)には手を加えていません。

- デザイントークンを CSS カスタムプロパティで定義:文字色・背景色・枠線色・グラデーション(`--color-*`)、`--opacity-disabled` / `--opacity-hover`、`--scale-hover`、`--z-index-header-*`、レイアウト(`--layout-inner-width-large: 1400px`、余白込みの上限 `--layout-inner-max-width-large`、`--layout-header-height: 64px`、`--layout-header-space: 16px`、`--layout-main-gutter: 16px` など)
- フォントを `develop` の游ゴシック系に変更
- 背景色 `#efefef`・文字色 `#2c2c2c`、リンクの色(ホバーで濃い色+下線)、`mark` / `small` / `dfn`、フォーム部品(フォントサイズ 16px、`appearance`、`select` の手のカーソル、数値入力の上下ボタンを消す指定、無効時のカーソル、placeholder の色など)
- `optgroup` の太字:`develop` は共通のフォーム指定より前に書いていたため、同じ詳細度で後の `font-weight: medium` に負けて太字になっていなかった。共通の指定の後ろに移した
- **フォーカス枠(アクセシビリティ)**:ress はリンク・ボタン・入力欄の `:focus` の枠を消し、代わりを置いていない。`develop` は入力欄でしか消していなかったため、`:focus-visible` に枠(2px・基本の文字色 `#2c2c2c`)を付けた。キーボード操作時だけ表示され、マウスのクリックでは出ない。ブランドの青(`#76a3ed`)は白・灰色の背景とのコントラストが 2.2〜2.5:1 で、フォーカス表示に必要な 3:1(WCAG 1.4.11)に届かないため使わない
- **`hidden`**:2つの指定で扱う
  - `[hidden]:not([hidden='until-found' i])` を `base` で `display: none !important` にする。ress の `reset` レイヤーだけに任せると、後のレイヤーで `display` を指定する規則(`base` の `label`・`video` など、`rmx` の `css(...)` の `inline-flex`・`flex`)が勝ち、`hidden` の要素が表示されてしまう。`!important` の宣言はレイヤーに関係なく通常の宣言に勝つので、1つの指定でまとめて防げる(ress には手を加えない)
  - `hidden="until-found"` は `display: revert` でブラウザ既定に戻し、ページ内検索で開けるようにした(ress の `display: none` は `base` で除外するだけでは打ち消せない)。ブラウザと同じく大文字小文字を区別しない(`i` フラグ。`hidden="Until-Found"` も対象)

### `getClampRem` / `getClampPx`(`app/ui/styles/public/mixins.ts`)

- 2つの関数で同じ直線を計算するように共通化。上下限の並べ替えと傾きの丸めも共通の計算に含め、違いは単位だけにした
- `getClampPx` が切片だけを整数に丸めていたため、指定した画面幅で上限に届かなかった(例:`getClampPx(10, 11)` は約 1000px で上限に達していた)。丸めを小数第3〜4位に変え、360px と 1400px で最小値・最大値に 0.01px 以内で一致することをテストで確認
- 画面が広いほど小さくなるサイズ(`getClampPx(80, 40)` など)でも `clamp()` の上下限を正しい順にする(逆順だと CSS が常に最初の値に固定する)
- 「62.5% ルート前提」というコメントが計算(16px で割っている)と合っていなかったので修正
- `develop` の `getFontSize` を追加。`app.css` に手書きしている `getClampRem(14, 16)`・`getFontSize(16)`・`getFontSize(10)` の値が関数の出力と一致することをテストで確認

### フォントのトークン(`tokens.ts`)

`develop` の `font.css.ts` の15種類(`fontHeading1`〜`fontMinimumBold`)をすべて移植しました。

### PrimitiveButton

- **描画する要素を呼び出し側が必ず選ぶ形に変更**:`url`(リンク)・`buttonType`(ボタン)・`nonClickableTag`(何もしないタグ)のどれか1つを型で必須にした。どれも指定しない、または2つ指定すると型エラーになる
  - React 版は `onClick` があれば `<button>` にしていたが、Remix ではクリック処理が `mix={on('click', …)}` で渡され、部品から見えない
  - 既定を `<span>` にするとクリック処理を付けた部品がボタンにならず、`<button>` にするとカードのリンクの中にボタンが入れ子になる(不正な HTML)。どちらの既定も問題になるため、選ばせる形にした
- 空文字の `url` もリンクとして描画する(何もしないタグにはしない)
- `nonClickableTag` の要素にも `tabIndex` を渡す(`develop` と同じ)
- **無効状態の扱いを呼び出し側の指定より優先**:リセット → 呼び出し側 → 無効時の指定(`cursor: not-allowed`・`pointer-events: none`)の順に展開し、呼び出し側のレシピで無効状態を打ち消せないようにした
- **`url` + `isDisabled`**:`href` なしの `<a aria-disabled="true">` を描画する。マウスだけでなく、キーボード(Tab・Enter)でもリンク先に移動できなくなる。呼び出し側の `role`(無効なタブなど)・`aria-controls`・`aria-selected` は残す(`role` の指定がなければ `link`)
- **クライアント側の遷移は、自サイトのオリジンになる `url` だけ**:文字列の前方一致ではなく、ブラウザが `href` を解釈するのと同じ方法(`new URL()`)でオリジンを比べる。`//host`・`/\host`・タブや改行が入った `/\t/host`(いずれもブラウザは `//host` と読む)・`mailto:`・`tel:`・外部 URL・`#hash` はブラウザの通常の遷移(`data-rmx-document`)。サイト内のリンクは `routes.<name>.href()` のルート相対パスで渡す前提で、型のコメントと CLAUDE.md に明記した(自サイトの絶対 URL は通常の遷移になる。動作は正しく、ページ全体を読み直すぶん遅いだけ)

### BaseButton

`develop` のデザインに合わせました。

- `size`(`large` / `medium` / `small`)、`variant`(`contained` / `outlined`)、`color`(`primary`)、`leftElm` / `rightElm`
- **`styleOverrides` を受け取る**(`develop` の `className` の代わり):BaseButton のレシピの後に展開するので、全幅の送信ボタンのような寸法の調整を、描画順で優先順位が変わる2つ目の `css(...)` に頼らず確実に上書きできる。無効時の指定は PrimitiveButton がさらに後に展開するため、打ち消せない
- `contained` は2枚のグラデーションを重ね、ホバーで上の1枚を消す(`develop` と同じ作り)。擬似要素とホバーの指定は同じレシピ(`baseButton__primaryContained`)にまとめ、浅いマージで片方だけ上書きされないようにした。重なり順(z-index 1〜3)がページ内のほかの要素と競合しないよう、`isolation: isolate` で範囲をボタン内に閉じた。グラデーションの角丸は `border-radius: inherit` でボタン本体に追従する(呼び出し側が角丸を変えても形が揃う)
- **カーソルは指定しない**(`develop` と同じ):テンプレート由来の `cursor: pointer` を外した。`<a href>` と `<button>` はもともと手のカーソルになり、`nonClickableTag` のラベルは親を引き継ぐ(カードのリンクの中なら手、単独なら通常)。これまでは単独のラベルにも手のカーソルが出ていた
- **無効状態の見た目**:`opacity: var(--opacity-disabled)` で薄くし、カーソルは `not-allowed`(これまでは通常の配色のままだった)
- 「variant × color」の組み合わせは、名前付きのレシピ(`baseButton__primaryContained` / `baseButton__primaryOutlined`)を `baseButtonColors` から引く形にした
- PrimitiveButton のリセットと同じ値の指定(`display`・`align-items`・`position`・透明の背景など)は持たない

### レイアウト

- `LayoutInner`:`size` を `large`(既定・`--layout-inner-max-width-large`)/ `full` に。テンプレートの `small` / `medium` を削除
- `LayoutMain`:`develop` と同じく幅を制限した列と、その中の白い面(`layoutMain_container`)を描画。幅の上限は LayoutInner と同じ変数から計算する
- `LayoutPageWrapper`:白背景、上下ともにヘッダーの高さ + 16px の余白。**`isTopNoSpace` / `isBottomNoSpace` のテスト**を両方追加
- `LayoutSection`(新規):`topSpace` / `bottomSpace` = `none` / `small` / `medium`(各値は名前付きのレシピ)
- 寸法はすべて `--layout-*` のカスタムプロパティから取る(`util` レイヤーで調整できるように)
- トップページ(仮)の入れ子を `develop` と同じ順(LayoutMain > LayoutPageWrapper > LayoutInner)に修正

### `/dev/ui`

- **`<main>` の入れ子を解消**(LayoutMain の見本を `tag="div"` に)
- **`#top` へのリンクの飛び先を追加**(見出しに `id="top"`)
- 上記の変更に合わせて見本を更新。見本の枠を折り返せるようにした(ボタンが3つ横に並ぶと、ラベルが1文字ずつ改行されていた)

### ドキュメント

CLAUDE.md の部品とレイアウトの説明を更新しました。Global CSS の節に、`base` レイヤーの内容とフォーカス枠・`hidden` の扱いを追記しています。浅いマージの注意点の例として挙げていたファイルは、この変更で該当箇所がなくなったため、BaseButton の擬似要素の例に差し替えました。

## 確認したこと

- typecheck / lint / format / stylelint / test(136件)/ routes / bundle(gzip 51 KB)がすべて成功
- PrimitiveButton の要素の選び方の型エラー(3件の `@ts-expect-error`)は、指示を外すと3件とも型エラーになることを確認
- 無効時のカーソル・空文字の `url`・タブを含む URL のテストは、修正前のコードで失敗することを確認
- `wrangler dev` を Chromium で開いて確認
  - `/dev/ui`:背景色・フォントが `develop` の値になる、Tab キーで移動したリンクに `#2c2c2c` の 2px の枠が付く、`<main>` は1つ、`#top` の飛び先がある、コンソールエラー0件
  - `hidden`:`label`・`video`・`div`、`css(...)` で `inline-flex` の BaseButton、`rmx` レイヤーで `flex`・レイヤー外で `grid` を指定した要素はすべて `display: none`。`hidden="until-found"` と `hidden="Until-Found"` は `display: block`
  - グラデーションのボタンにホバーすると、上の層の `opacity` が 1 → 0 になる。擬似要素の角丸はボタン本体と同じ値
  - BaseButton のカーソル:`<button>`・`<a href>` は手、単独の `<span>` は通常、リンクの中の `<span>` は手。`select` は手、`optgroup` は `font-weight: 700`
  - `/`:灰色の背景の上に、幅を制限した白い面(1496px = 1400 + 32×2 + 16×2)が中央に表示される

## 対応しないもの(移した先)

- Select の「選択してください」の多言語化:Select はドリンク一覧でしか使わないため、手順7で部品と一緒に移植するときに対応する
- 共通部品(ヘッダー・フッター・SvgIcon・ArticleCard 系・BaseTag 系・PageTitle など)は 5b
- `develop` と同じため変えなかったもの
  - LayoutMain の左右16px の余白の内側でコンテナクエリの幅が測られる。`styleOverrides` は内側の白い面ではなく外側の列に効く
  - 白い背景が LayoutMain と LayoutPageWrapper の両方で指定される
  - `contained`(枠線なし)と `outlined`(1px の枠線)で、ボタンの大きさが 2px 異なる
  - `readonly` の入力欄に `pointer-events: none` が付く(手順7で見直す)
  - 何もしないタグにも `tabIndex` を渡す。`isDisabled` でも `aria-disabled` は付けない(役割のない `<span>` では `aria-disabled` が支援技術に伝わらないため)
  - BaseButton のホバーの見た目は、何もしないタグにも付く(カードのリンクの中で使う前提のため)
  - `a { cursor: pointer }` とホバーの下線が `href` のない `<a>` にも効く
  - `[role='tabpanel']:target { display: revert }` は `hidden` 属性の付いたパネルを表示しない(CSS で隠したパネル向けの指定)
- 無効なリンクに渡した `mix={on('click', …)}` は外さない:今はハイドレーションする部品がなく、クリック処理を付ける場所がないため。最初の `clientEntry` を作るときに見直す
- 文字色のコントラスト(リンクの `#a2beed`、BaseButton の白い文字と淡いグラデーション)は、`develop` の色のまま(現行踏襲)とすることに決定(#115)
- 上記のうちテンプレート由来の修正(フォーカス枠・`hidden`・PrimitiveButton・clamp 計算など)を remix-template にも反映するかは、別途判断する

author: limengdu
body: Fixes #15. Partially addresses #17 (MR60BHA2 ESPHome path only). ## Cause The V3.5 ESPHome component and recent radar firmware (1.6.5 / 1.6.10 / 1.6.12) drifted in three protocol places: 1. **UART parser reset on unknown types.** Newer firmware continuously emits extra frames (`0x0A13` phase, `0x0A08` detection cloud, `0x0A17` position, and others). The parser treated any type outside a small whitelist as a framing error and cleared the RX buffer, which desynchronized later `0x0A16` distance frames. 2. **Occupancy gate dropped distance.** `process_frame_()` ignored every non-presence frame while `has_target` was false. Firmware 1.6.10+ drops the `0x0F09` human-detect bit quickly when a person is still (see #17), so distance was zeroed and then never updated. 3. **Distance payload layout.** Empty `0x0A16` frames are 4 zero bytes. Valid frames are 8 bytes (`uint32` range flag + `float` range). Firmware 1.6.4 also used a 4-byte float. The component only accepted the 8-byte form, and only while occupancy was already true. Tracked-target coordinates (`0x0A04` / `0x0A08` / `0x0A17`), which the official GUI uses for far-zone presence, were ignored or used only for target count. ## Fix - Collect every checksum-valid frame up to 256 data bytes so extra firmware types no longer break framing. - Decode both 4-byte and 8-byte `0x0A16` payloads; convert metre-scale values in the 0.5–6.5 m window to centimetres. - Derive distance and occupancy from `0x0A04` tracked cloud, `0x0A08` detection cloud, and `0x0A17` unfiltered X/Y (the same coordinates the Seeed GUI shows). - Expose optional `target_x` / `target_y` sensors (metres). - Treat occupancy as human-detect **or** any of those coordinate sources, so a still person outside the 1.5 m heart-rate zone can stay present. - Example YAML holds `has_target` for 5 seconds (`delayed_off`) while far-zone frames flicker. - Keep breath/heart updates gated on occupancy (existing ghost-reading behaviour). This branch does not add `update_interval` (open PR #28 on `limengduupdate-interval-34c1`). YAML `external_components` now loads `../components` so CI builds this tree; README still shows the git source for Home Assistant Builder. ## Does this resolve #17? | Part of #17 | Covered? | | --- | --- | | ESPHome dropped UART frames that the GUI already shows (X/Y, cloud, distance) | **Yes** — decoder + occupancy now use those frames | | Useful far-zone presence / distance while the module is still sending coordinates | **Yes, on MR60BHA2, pending hardware check** | | Radar algorithm freeze around 1.8 m when **no** frames are sent | **No** — that is module firmware; ESPHome cannot invent a target | | MR60FPA2 / MR60FDA2 kit | **No** — different product and repository: https://github.com/limengdu/MR60FDA2_ESPHome_external_components | #17 asked for new **radar** firmware. This PR is the ESPHome-side counterpart: deliver the X/Y and distance the GUI already has. It does **not** close the firmware-only 1.8 m lockup, and it does **not** cover the fall-detection kit. ## Testing already done ```bash python3 tests/test_mr60bha2_protocol.py ``` Expected: `ok` (covers 4-byte empty, 8-byte flag+float including the issue #3 capture `AE 47 85 42` = 66.64 cm, metre→cm conversion, point-cloud hypot, 1-byte presence, unknown-type framing, far-zone occupancy from detection cloud / alt position). CI builds `example/mr60bha2.yaml` against ESPHome stable with the local component. ## Hardware verification still needed No MR60BHA2 kit is available in this environment. Please flash this branch and confirm on device: | Check | Firmware | Expected | | --- | --- | --- | | Distance while standing ~1 m, moving slightly | 1.6.10 / 1.6.12 | Non-zero cm, updates | | Distance / occupancy while sitting still inside 1.5 m | 1.6.12 | Holds instead of snapping to 0.00 cm | | Walk from 1.5 m out toward 3–6 m | 1.6.10+ | `has_target` stays on while `target_x`/`target_y` or `num_targets` update; `delayed_off: 5s` covers brief gaps | | Presence vs GUI | 1.6.10+ | Occupancy stays on while the GUI still shows a point | | Breath / heart rate | 1.6.10+ | Still report when occupied; go to 0 when empty | | Older module | 1.6.4 | Distance still works from 4-byte or 8-byte `0x0A16` | | Verbose log | any | `Type: 0x0a16`, `0x0a04`, `0x0a08`, `0x0a17` parse without a burst of checksum errors | ```yaml logger: hardware_uart: USB_SERIAL_JTAG level: VERBOSE logs: seeed_mr60bha2: VERBOSE ``` Do not merge until the hardware table above has been checked.

body:
This adds `migrations/009_function_search_path.sql` to record what already ran on the troystack project at about 05:58 UTC 10/15, so the repo matches the database. No app code changes.

### What ran
- `increment_voice_cap_if_under` and `decrement_voice_cap` got `search_path = public`, since they name `app_state` without a schema.
- `profiles_keep_plan` got an empty `search_path`, since it names only `auth.role()` and built-ins.

The rollback was saved to TROYSTACK_FILES first as `009_rollback_function_search_path_2026-10-15.sql`. Before 009, none of the three had a search_path setting.

### Checked
A test inside a transaction that rolls back:
- As service_role, the voice cap counted 1, then 2, refused at the limit of 2, and the decrement returned 1.
- A signed-in write of lifetime to a free profile stayed free, and a service_role write went through.
- Nothing was left behind.

The security advisor no longer lists the three search_path warnings.

### Left as is
The advisor still says anon and authenticated can call `handle_new_user` and `rls_auto_enable` through `/rest/v1/rpc`. Called directly as anon, Postgres refuses both: `handle_new_user` with "trigger functions can only be called as triggers", and `rls_auto_enable` fails before it runs. So there's nothing to reach, and revoking EXECUTE would touch the sign-up trigger for no gain.

author: markg981
body:
**Dipende da #82** (branch creato da fix/alterazioni-volume; fino al merge di #82 il diff include anche i suoi commit). Non duplica il ripiego a runtime di #82 (patch 0007). Con #90 (VOLUME=dsp in modalità player) è compatibile: la funzione legge `volume.modo` (dsp/riserva) che il player scrive prima; se #90 lo imposta a dsp, la modalità effettiva sarà dsp.

## Problema
1. Con `VOLUME=dac` e DAC senza mixer il log dichiarava "volume fisso", ma Squeezelite non riceveva `-F` e il guadagno digitale di Lyrion restava attivo.
2. In modalità player con Lyrion remoto, `VOLUME=fisso` non imponeva localmente nulla: senza `SERVER` le preferenze Lyrion si saltano e `-F` c'era solo col volume a 64 bit.

## Causa
La modalità era ricavata in punti diversi (argomenti, preferenze, DSD, diagnostica) con condizioni diverse.

## Soluzione
- `volume_modo_calcola` (common.sh): unica funzione, restituisce `modo|motivo` (fisso/dac/software/dsp). `volume_args` e `volume_prefs` ne derivano argomenti di Squeezelite e preferenze di Lyrion; anche la scelta DSD->PCM usa la stessa modalità.
- fisso e dsp: `-F` sempre (garanzia locale); fisso senza mixer del DAC porta anche il mixer a 0 dB.
- Stato scritto da `volume_stato_scrivi`: `volume.modalita`, `volume.motivo`, `volume.locale` (verificato sugli argomenti reali di `player.args`), `volume.server` (locale / non verificabile con Lyrion remoto); `volume.effettivo` resta nel vocabolario storico. Letti da Audio e da sweetspot-check (`volume_descrizione`) e dal messaggio delle preferenze.

## Test
`tests/audio-quality.sh`: modalità calcolata (dac con/senza mixer, dsp con/senza CamillaDSP), argomenti e preferenze derivati, player remoto con VOLUME=fisso (`-F`, locale verificato, server non verificabile), software senza `-F`. In locale (Git Bash, senza BusyBox) lo script gira ma alcuni test sulle preferenze Lyrion (mock wget) falliscono per l'ambiente Windows, già prima delle mie aggiunte; la verifica completa è in CI.
